known_outcome: Council answer (leakage): yes. Section 104 of the 2018 IBC and IFC lets the building or fire official evaluate proposed modifications or alternative methods for Group I occupancies built as R-4; approval is allowed only if the proposal keeps the code's intent, does not lessen health, accessibility, life-safety, fire or structural requirements, and meets the criteria of IBC Section 104.11.
